name: Skinner Fideo Cut Spaghetti / Vermicelli in Broth
whyItWorks: Short 1-inch cut thin vermicelli noodles that cook rapidly in broth. Their diminutive size eliminates any stricture hazard or heavy chewing needs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast lightly in 1 tsp olive oil, then add 2 cups mild chicken broth and simmer for 6 minutes until tender (sopa seca or sopa aguada style without spicy chili).
